lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular white spots arranged in four to five identifiable horizontal rows extending from the posterior margin of the gill slits toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint, vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal rows of spots, creating a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature is visible along the dorsal-lateral interface, showing a sharp pixel intensity gradient with a highlighted upper margin and a shadowed lower margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
